# Shruti 1.4.0
This release makes the audio path harder to break and moving from SoundSource more complete.
- Each controlled app now gets its own isolated audio helper. If one Core Audio graph or Audio Unit fails, that app returns to the direct macOS path without taking the mixer—or another app—with it. - SoundSource migration now transfers the exact Audio Unit preset when the same plug-in is installed. Missing plug-ins remain explicit and Waves NS1 still has a safe built-in fallback. - The current mixer, protected-app list and system routes survive restart as before. - The optimized product suite now passes 320 checks, including exact preset restore and tap containment support, with eight full processing chains averaging below 0.4 ms on the release test Mac. - A compatibility table now separates physical hardware passes from build-only coverage.
Licensing infrastructure is ready for a three-Mac personal license, but public payment remains closed until a real Paddle purchase, email delivery and refund are completed without manual help.
